summary: scripts/evidence-gc computes a pure plan of whole trees and whole input keys to delete from git data alone (branch tips, main's history, .st/evidence-retention.json, main's tip time) and deletes exactly that; it no longer asks GitHub for open pull requests.

replay.detail: Operator script and its retention file only; no record, signature or verifier rule changes.

schema.detail: New file .st/evidence-retention.json (version 1: main_days, branch_days, grace_hours, soft_records, cap_records), read from main by scripts/evidence-gc.

rules.detail: GC keeps the trees of every branch tip committed within 30 days and of main's first-parent commits within 3 days of main's tip time, and their input keys; it deletes a dead tree's records together and never one record of a tree it keeps. The --github, --soft, --cap, --keep-main-days, --grace-hours and --now options are replaced by the retention file and --as-of. Nothing runs it automatically yet.

compatibility.detail: Nothing runs evidence-gc automatically yet; a manual run needs the retention file on main or --retention.

manual.detail: No manual step in this change.

recovery.detail: Revert restores the previous options; no state is written outside the evidence refs a run deletes.
